prose: Dutch-language post: Bert Hubert's account of opening the Kunsten '92 Paradiso debate on AI - two hours of discussion for an arts-sector audience, with an excellent video recording of the whole event. He enjoyed 'gluren bij de buren' (peeking at the neighbors): as a tech-scene nerd among artists, he was struck by the care taken over interaction between speakers, who met beforehand to coordinate their contributions. (The page is in Dutch; the wiki keeps content in English.)
highlights: Hubert opened the Kunsten '92 Paradiso debate on AI (arts-sector audience)
A tech nerd 'peeking at the neighbors': he valued the cross-sector exchange
Noted the speakers' deliberate pre-event coordination
Page in Dutch; video of the full event linked from the post
